title:
A résumé is more
than keywords.
body:
Give your team a clearer way
to review the evidence.
voice: Go beyond keywords. Give your hiring team a clearer way to review every résumé.
phonemes: ɡˌoʊ bᵻjˌɔnd kˈiːwɜːdz. ɡˈɪv jʊɹ hˈaɪɚɹɪŋ tˈiːm ɐ klˈɪɹɚ wˈeɪ tə ɹᵻvjˈuː ˈɛvɹi ˈɹɛzjumeɪ .

title:
Your team.
Your criteria.
body:
Type what matters.
Define the evidence to look for.
voice: Define your own criteria. Type the skills and evidence that matter for the role.
phonemes: dᵻfˈaɪn jʊɹ ˈoʊn kɹaɪtˈiəɹɪə. tˈaɪp ðə skˈɪlz ænd ˈɛvɪdəns ðæt mˈæɾɚ fɚðə ɹˈoʊl.

title:
Set the threshold.
Keep the context.
body:
Flag mentorship below 70%
for a closer human review.
voice: Set a threshold. Flag mentorship below seventy percent for a closer look.
phonemes: sˈɛt ɐ θɹˈɛʃoʊld. flˈæɡ mˈɛntɔːɹʃˌɪp bᵻlˌoʊ sˈɛvənti pɚsˈɛnt fɚɹə klˈoʊsɚ lˈʊk.

title:
Your rubric.
Applied consistently.
body:
Run the review against
your team's criteria.
voice: Run the review. Fast decision models apply your criteria to the evidence.
phonemes: ɹˈʌn ðə ɹᵻvjˈuː. fˈæst dᵻsˈɪʒən mˈɑːdəlz ɐplˈaɪ jʊɹ kɹaɪtˈiəɹɪə tə ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns.

title:
See the signals
take shape.
voice: Watch the signals emerge. Mentorship reaches a ninety-two percent yes probability.
phonemes: wˈɑːtʃ ðə sˈɪɡnəlz ɪmˈɜːdʒ. mˈɛntɔːɹʃˌɪp ɹˈiːtʃᵻz ɐ nˈaɪntitˈuː pɚsˈɛnt jˈɛs pɹˌɑːbəbˈɪlᵻɾi.

title:
Keep the source
in view.
body:
Original résumé. Reviewed evidence.
Your team's judgment.
voice: Check the source résumé. Keep every interpretation connected to evidence, and the decision with your team.
phonemes: tʃˈɛk ðə sˈɔːɹs ˈɹɛzjumeɪ . kˈiːp ˈɛvɹi ɪntˌɜːpɹɪtˈeɪʃən kənˈɛktᵻd tʊ ˈɛvɪdəns, ænd ðə dᵻsˈɪʒən wɪð jʊɹ tˈiːm.

title:
Your criteria.
Clearer decisions.
body: Bring your team's criteria into focus.
voice: Your criteria. Clearer evidence. Better informed decisions. Résumé Lens.
phonemes: jʊɹ kɹaɪtˈiəɹɪə. klˈɪɹɚɹ ˈɛvɪdəns. bˈɛɾɚɹ ɪnfˈɔːɹmd dᵻsˈɪʒənz. ˈɹɛzjumeɪ lɛnz .
